text:
jamie: Quick sync — holiday surge projection landed. Model shows a sharp microburst around Dec 20-27 (peak window ~48h). We need a procurement decision: short leases vs buys + warm-pool sizing.

jamie: TL;DR numbers: additional GPU hours needed ~350k GPU-hours for the peak week, baseline capacity covers ~65% of that. Peak RPS ~2.7x baseline.

evan: Can you drop the assumptions? latency/SLO targets?

jamie: Target P95 latency <= 350ms for hosted API generation tier. SLOs must hold at peak. Assumptions: avg request length 250 tokens, avg tokens/sec ~20, effective utilization with batching ~0.58.

priya: Important: APAC demand skews more to tiny-chunk chat — higher QPS but lower seq len. That increases hot-shard count (KV cache pressure).

jamie: Procurement options considered:
```
1) Buy 200x A100 (40GB) — lead time 10-12 weeks, capex ~$1.6M, ops overhead: racking + power; amortize over 36mo
2) Short-term lease (3 months) — ~200 devices equivalent, cost ~$420k for 3 months, available in 4-6 weeks via partner
3) Hybrid: buy 100 + lease 100 — reduces capex and gives flexibility
4) Warm-pool + burst on cloud for APAC — pre-warm warm-pool with 50 GPUs, rest burst to partner
```

sara: Finance: running numbers quickly, lease is ~26% of buy cost in year1 but higher $/token long-term. Need IRR calc baseline. Also watch balance sheet impact for buy.

evan: Ops concerns: racks and PSU capacity in FRA cluster are near 85%. NA has headroom but shipping times for chassis +/- NICs also matter.

priya: Model side: quantized variants reduce GPU-hours by ~18% for generation workloads, so effective demand might be ~287k GPU-hours not 350k if we accelerate quant rollout. We can target that as risk mitigation.

jamie: Network note: cross-region KV replication during surge causes egress spikes. If we route more APAC traffic to APAC partners we'll avoid intercontinental egress and lower latency.

ops-bot: DEPLOY: warm-pool-prewarm scheduled for 2024-12-15T02:00Z (ETA 3h).

evan: Procurement timeline constraints: vendor lead time + customs -> buy by 2024-10-01 to arrive before Dec. Lease slots close by 2024-11-01. Decision must be vendor-committable by 2024-09-25 for buy, 2024-10-20 for lease.

jamie: Proposed recommendation (ops + product): go hybrid — buy 120 for NA long term, lease 120 for APAC+EU for seasonal; accelerate quant rollout to shave ~18% demand; pre-warm 50 GPUs in APAC warm pool.

priya: +1 on hybrid. Can push quant to production on a canary (10% traffic) by Nov 10. Need model infra support.

sara: From finance, hybrid acceptable if ops commits to decommission plan for leased gear and capex approvals by 9/30. Need final numbers on monthly burn for leased vs bought.

evan: Two operational flags: 1) power/capacity in FRA needs mitigation if we route more EU to FRA; 2) try to secure a fallback partner that supports NVLink-less instances — impacts perf but better than throttling.

jamie: Action items:
- evan: confirm rack/power headroom in NA/FRA by 2024-09-15
- priya: quantify quantization rollout impact and canary plan by 2024-09-20
- sara: run cost P&L for buy vs lease vs hybrid (36mo and 6mo scenarios) by 2024-09-22
- ops-bot: schedule warm-pool prewarm for proposed dates and validate autoscaler config

sara: I'll block calendar for decision review 2024-09-23 16:00 PT.

evan: Noted — also will ping facilities about temporary power expansion options (UPS/rental).

jamie: One more: if supply tight, fallback is to throttle lower-priority tenant tiers and enable progressive degradation (reduce max seq len, stricter batching). We'll document degradation plan.

priya: I'll prepare eval prompts to monitor quality drift from quantized models and set alert thresholds.

jamie: Thanks all. If anyone has vendor contacts for quick lease slots (APAC focus) DM me. :pray:
